abstract: Affective computing has progressed from categorical emotion recognition to open-ended affective analysis with large multimodal models. Yet affective science describes emotion as an unfolding process shaped by appraisal, regulation, and social interpretation, which remains underexplored computationally. We propose TRACE, a cognition-oriented framework that formalizes an affective episode through three interrelated stages: Condition, Affect, and Effect, integrating observable cues with cognitive factors such as internal stance and regulation of emotional display. Based on this formulation, TRACE-Bench evaluates multimodal models in real-world social scenes through five tasks spanning grounded affect recognition, regulation decoding, cause reasoning, effect reasoning, and full-chain reconstruction, with 3,746 structured question-answer pairs over 646 videos. A matched human-model comparison reveals a substantial performance gap, while affect-specialized models also generally lag behind general-purpose MLLMs. Model outputs show recurring failures, including treating displayed behavior as genuine feeling and fabricating unsupported events during long-chain generation. We further propose TRACER, a cognition-grounded structured reasoning method that couples each inference with explicit premises from factual observations, cognitive appraisals, and established upstream conclusions, forming a traceable graph of intermediate and target conclusions. TRACER outperforms all evaluated model baselines on each of the five tasks. Project page: https://cogaffc.github.io/TRACE
abstract_zh: 情感计算已经从分类情感识别发展到基于大型多模态模型的开放式情感分析。然而，情感科学将情感描述为一个由评估、调节和社会解释塑造的展开过程，这在计算上仍然未得到充分探索。我们提出了TRACE，一个面向认知的框架，通过三个相互关联的阶段：条件、情感和效果，形式化情感事件，整合可观察的线索与内部立场和情感表现调节等认知因素。基于这一框架，TRACE-Bench通过五个任务评估真实世界社交场景中的多模态模型，这些任务涵盖了基础情感识别、调节解码、原因推理、效果推理和全链重建，共有3,746个结构化问答对，涉及646个视频。与人类模型的匹配比较显示出显著的性能差距，而专注于情感的模型通常也落后于通用的多语言大模型（MLLMs）。模型输出显示出反复出现的失败，包括将表现出的行为视为真实情感，以及在长链生成过程中虚构不支持的事件。我们进一步提出了TRACER，一种基于认知的结构化推理方法，将每个推理与来自事实观察、认知评估和已建立的上游结论的明确前提结合，形成一个可追踪的中间和目标结论图。TRACER在五个任务中超越了所有评估的模型基线。项目页面：https://cogaffc.github.io/TRACE

title: Cognition-Oriented Emotion Tracing from Causes to Consequences in Real-World Social Scenes
title_zh: 面向认知的情感追踪：从原因到后果的真实世界社交场景
